tldr: The UN's top court ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority in an unprecedented verdict.
Anthropic's IPO set a new record, valued at $81.3 billion, making it the most valuable initial public offering of all time.
The US has officially lost its measles elimination status, as a strain of the disease has persisted in the country for over a year.

The S&P 500 experienced a slight decline, potentially reflecting broader market concerns about AI debt and an overall 'oversold' market condition mentioned in some reports.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: Anthropic's IPO is the largest in history, raising $81.3 billion and setting a precedent for future AI lab debuts, while also testing the company's commitment to its "safe AI" reputation.
Australian physicists have demonstrated a proof-of-concept for communicating using gravity, successfully transmitting a message in binary code through a brick wall.
Blue Origin will launch satellites equipped with Google's Tensor Processing Units into space in 2029 as part of Google's Project Suncatcher, a plan to deploy AI server satellites.

world.summary: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority during a 2017 military crackdown, marking the first time the court has made such a ruling against a state.

The leaders of China, Russia, and the US issued a "peace declaration" following an unprecedented trilateral summit, outlining priorities like UN reform and boosting oil supplies, but notably omitting any mention of the wars in Ukraine or Iran.
Ukraine's allies are meeting in Berlin to discuss air defense, energy, and financial support, following a trilateral meeting between the US, China, and Russia that did not address the conflict.

Southern California is preparing for a fierce winter storm, which has already caused record rainfall in the northern part of the state, leading to temporary grounding of planes, flooded roads, power outages, and evacuation orders in some areas.

us.summary: Florida is set to record its 20th execution of the year, establishing a new record for the state, even as other states are reducing their use of the death penalty.

The Pan American Health Organization has announced that the U.S. has officially lost its measles elimination status, reclassifying the disease as endemic because a strain has persisted for over a year.
Recent changes to SNAP food aid regulations require older adults up to age 65 to work or volunteer to receive benefits, impacting individuals who may have retired early for family care.

science.summary: Australian scientists conducted a proof-of-concept experiment, successfully using gravity to transmit a message in binary code through a brick wall, suggesting a new method of communication.
The U.S. has officially lost its measles elimination status, as the Pan American Health Organization now classifies the disease as endemic due to a strain persisting for over a year.
